title: Han Lie's Shadow
next_chapter_hook: When Han Lie thought victory was assured, Chen Ji slightly curled his lips in a corner unseen— a chess game of strategic retreat was secretly unfolding.

text.content: The aftermath of the Imperial Court's messenger's狼狈 departure had not yet settled, yet an eerie silence filled Tianqing Sect's Council Hall. Chen Ji stood in the corner, beneath a mask of timidity, those pitch-black eyes taking in all the hidden killing intent outside the hall. Though the Tianji Record's aura was concealed, it seemed to leave a trace in the void, attracting even more dangerous existences.

dialogue.content: A servant disciple of Tianqing Sect? Hmph, this seat thought it would be some remarkable figure, yet it could actually make the Imperial Court's messenger suffer.

text.content: An overwhelmingly domineering aura crushed in from outside the hall, like an ancient great beast awakening, carrying the might to burn mountains and boil seas straight toward the Council Hall. Chen Ji raised his gaze to see an iron tower-like figure descending through the air, surrounded by Xuanwu Sect's distinctive Dark Black Spiritual Light, the surrounding air twisted into ripples by the chilling killing intent. Han Lie, Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, the absolute overlord of the younger generation among the three major sects.

dialogue.content: H-Han Shixiong? This insignificant one is merely a servant from Tianqing Sect, how dare I trouble the shixiong to come in person...

text.content: Chen Ji bowed with hands clasped, his posture reaching the extreme of humility, shoulders trembling slightly— to onlookers, clearly a appearance of being scared out of his wits. However, beneath that lowered face, the subtle curve of his lips revealed an almost imperceptible cold intent. Han Lie arrived faster than Chen Ji had anticipated; it seems the exposed aura of the Tianji Record truly startled certain people who should not have been startled.

dialogue.content: What pretending? Don't think this seat doesn't know about your performance in the trial secret realm that day. A mere servant, yet able to render this seat's Three-Turn Dark Armor Art useless— the secrets you harbor are far more than this seat imagined.

text.content: Han Lie stood with hands clasped behind his back, looking down at Chen Ji from above, killing intent in his eyes condensing into something nearly tangible. His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached everyone present, carrying undeniable pressure: "This seat comes representing the three major sects. The Tianji Record has reappeared in the mortal world, all forces desire to obtain it— and the aura on you, this seat will never misidentify."

choice.prompt: Facing Han Lie's interrogation and the pressure from the three major sects, Chen Ji needs to make a choice—

choices.description: With an even more humble posture to confuse Han Lie, causing him to underestimate his strength, silently accumulating power for counterattack.
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may press step by step

text.content: Chen Ji thudded to his knees, his whole body trembling like a sieve, voice带着上了哭腔: "Shixiong is wise, this one truly knows nothing! That day in the trial secret realm, this one merely had good luck, stumbled into it by accident..."

choices.description: Use sharp words to expose Han Lie'sblustering, making him lose face publicly, intimidating the lesser ones.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly straightened up, that timid expression like a torn-off mask instantly vanishing, replaced by a touch of cold mockery: "Three-Turn Dark Armor Art rendered useless? Han Shixiong's meaning is— you lost?"

text.content: The hall erupted in an uproar. Everyone looked at that servant disciple who had been trembling moments ago in disbelief, now daring to speak to Han Lie in such a dismissive tone. Han Lie's expression abruptly darkened, those tiger eyes nearly spitting literal flames of fury, the surrounding air warping and deforming under his rage.

dialogue.content: Bold! This seat shall see if that mouth of yours can survive three moves!

text.content: Han Lie struck with his palm,裹挟着足以毁山裂石的恐怖灵压, directly targeting Chen Ji's face. However, just as everyone thought the servant was doomed, an elderly voice rang out from behind the hall: "Han Shi侄何必跟一个小辈计较？天青宗的地盘，还轮不到外人撒野。" Ling Yuan, Tianqing Sect's former Sect Master, appeared at just the right moment.

dialogue.content: Old Ling, your Tianqing Sect is harboring the inheritor of the Tianji Record. Do you wish to become an enemy of the Three Great Sects? This seat advises you to think clearly—the existence behind this is not someone you can provoke.

text.content: Ling Yuan's expression shifted slightly, clearly stung by the words 'the existence behind this.' Chen Ji observed all of this, sneering internally—so even the old fox has something he fears. He calmly observed the reactions of everyone in the hall, carving every subtle change of expression into his mind.

dialogue.content: Junior Han speaks too severely. The Tianqing Sect has always been on good terms with the Three Great Sects—where is this talk of becoming enemies? It's just that this disciple is indeed an ordinary Servant Disciple. If there was any offense, this old man apologizes on his behalf.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan stepped in to mediate, but Han Lie clearly wasn't about to let this go. Chen Ji needed to decide his next move—

choices.description: Use Ling Yuan's protection to temporarily escape, redirect the conflict between the Three Great Sects and Tianqing Sect, and slip away unnoticed.
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie might investigate to the end

text.content: Chen Ji promptly shrank back into the corner again, donning his timid mask once more, lowering his brows and not speaking. Seeing this, Han Lie's lips curved into a triumphant cold smile: 'Smart of you. However—this seat gives you three days. If you can't give the Three Great Sects an answer by then, don't blame this seat for being merciless.'

choices.description: Escalate the provocation against Han Lie, driving him to lose composure and embarrass himself publicly, while secretly drawing out clues about the higher powers at play.
choices.visible_reward: Draw out the snake from its hole
choices.risk_hint: Risk being killed on the spot

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed lightly, that laughter echoing sharply through the silent Council Hall: 'Three days? Senior Han overestimates himself. That one behind you—does he really dare show himself?'

text.content: Once these words fell, the atmosphere in the hall instantly froze. Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply, a subtle hint of panic flashing across his arrogant face—clearly, Chen Ji's words had struck a vital point. A gleam also flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes as he gazed thoughtfully at Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: You... how could you possibly know!

text.content: Han Lie lost his composure. This genius who claimed to be the number one among the younger generation of the Three Great Sects had actually shown fear in front of all the guests. Whispering immediately spread through the hall, and the gazes that had previously regarded Chen Ji with disdain now held more meaningful contemplation. Chen Ji mused internally—the hidden thread indeed exists, and it's concealed so deeply that even Han Lie is merely a chess piece.

Ling Yuan suddenly spoke, spiritual pressure pouring down like a mountain, forcibly separating the two with daggers drawn. His gaze swept between Chen Ji and Han Lie before finally landing on Chen Ji, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes: 'Today's matter ends here. In three days, this old man will personally lead people to the imperial capital to give the Three Great Sects an answer.'

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan forcibly ended the confrontation, but Chen Ji had already calculated his plan—

choices.text: Reel in the net and set the board
choices.description: Submit to Ling Yuan's arrangement, secretly use Han Lie as bait to lure out the higher powers behind him, and eliminate them all.

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back and bowed again, his humble posture making Han Lie even more pleased with himself. Yet just as everyone thought the commotion would end there, Chen Ji's voice rang low in Han Lie's ear: 'In three days, at the Imperial Capital— I hope whoever stands behind Brother Han can come along.'

choices.text: Establish Dominance by Exploiting the Momentum
choices.description: Under Ling Yuan's protection, publicly announcing his intention to personally go to the Imperial Capital, facing the Three Great Sects with the bearing of a master, striking fear into lesser threats.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji straightened his waist, all timidity shed, replaced by a regal pride that seemed to look down upon the world: 'No need to wait three days— tonight, Chen will accompany Sect Master Ling to the Imperial Capital. If the Three Sects want an explanation, I shall give them one myself!'

text.content: Han Lie's face turned ashen as he departed from the Tianqing Sect. When that iron-tower-like figure strode through the void, the residual spiritual pressure still made everyone in the hall tremble. Yet Chen Ji stood motionless, gazing at the departing figure, a calculating cold light flickering in the depths of his eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment within his body trembled slightly, as if warning of something.

The three-day deadline was merely the first chess piece he had set in motion. The forces behind Han Lie, the covetous ones drawn by the exposed Tianji Record, and that old fox Ling Yuan's true intentions— all would converge at the Imperial Capital into an intricate chess game. What Chen Ji sought was never three days of peace, but the chance to net all his enemies in one fell swoop. Tonight's storm had only just begun.
